title: Compassion Kickoff
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett introduces the year's study theme of compassion by asking small groups to finish the sentence "compassion is," then sets out Stanford's four-step definition and the near enemy of pity. Paul Gilbert's list of fears about giving compassion, receiving it, and turning it toward oneself is read aloud so listeners can notice which ones catch. Nomon also takes up the koan of Yunyan and Daowu on the Bodhisattva of great compassion's many hands and eyes, and dwells on Daowu's image of reaching for a pillow in the dark. The evening ends with Alan Sinaki's letter about a trip to a Rohingya refugee camp in Bangladesh, and a donation box set out in the room.
